# We Create This

Personal site by James Daniel Whitford: a collection of small, offline-first
web apps and a blog, all built with vanilla JavaScript and no frameworks.
Every app is a progressive web app that works fully offline after first load.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://wecreatethis.com/blog/): writing on development tools and side projects
- [Dev Tools](https://wecreatethis.com/blog/dev-tools): posts about development tooling and workflow
- [Sitemap](https://wecreatethis.com/blog/sitemap.xml): every published section

## Apps

- [Birdle](https://wecreatethis.com/birdle/): bird spotting game using the eBird API
- [Bird Bingo](https://wecreatethis.com/bird-bingo/): daily and practice bingo cards built from nearby eBird sightings
- [Hardle](https://wecreatethis.com/hardle/): word guessing game with a daily puzzle and practice mode
- [Beautiful Mind](https://wecreatethis.com/beautiful-mind/): offline notes app with text, image, video, and audio
- [Tarot](https://wecreatethis.com/tarot/): tarot card reading app
- [Perfect Day](https://wecreatethis.com/perfectday/): offline-first hiking map with lazy tile caching and GPS
- [Starry Night](https://wecreatethis.com/starrynight/): skywatching conditions, cloud cover, moon phase, planet visibility
- [Voice Notes](https://wecreatethis.com/voice-notes/): voice recording with AI transcription
- [Git Notes](https://wecreatethis.com/git-notes/): note-taking app with a GitHub-inspired theme

## Notes

- Content is rendered client-side from markdown; blog posts live at
  `/blog/content/{section}/{post}/index.md` and are listed in
  [the content manifest](https://wecreatethis.com/blog/content-manifest.json).
- Blog posts are addressed as fragments on their section page, so
  `/blog/dev-tools#some-post` refers to a single post.
